description: DCR along the parallactic direction (mas) = tan z * (a + b_blue*min(c - c_break, 0) + b_red*max(c - c_break, 0)), c = clip(c_rel, c_min, c_max), c_rel = (g-i) - (-0.56 + 1.34*ccdbprp). Subtract from the measured position.

fit.selection: Gaia stars, sigma < 10 mas, |c_rel| < 3, before any correction
